paragraph1.text: Have you ever secretly admired someone? Admired their good looks. Admired their talents. Admired how cute they are. Anything that leads you to seek out and find out what they look like or what they do. Especially nowadays, in the age of social media, which makes it much easier for people to secretly admire someone.
